name: Mika Santos
quote: The Ube Cream Latte got me through my capstone defense. The outlets and the no-rush vibe don't hurt either.

name: Paolo Reyes
quote: Kapeng Kanlungan is the only coffee that keeps me awake without making me anxious. We hold our sketch dates here every Friday.

name: Angela Cruz
quote: They set aside a long table for our org meetings. The Strawberry Matcha is a hit, and the prices fit a student budget.

name: Jerome Villanueva
quote: With the student discount, a Tuna Melt Pandesal and a drink costs less than a fast-food meal. Easy choice.

name: Bea Navarro
quote: Iced Tablea Cloud after a long duty is the best. It's warm and homey, just like the name says.

name: Carlo Mendoza
quote: I write here most mornings. The staff remember my order, and the Sea Salt Spanish is dangerously good.
